text: I can't say for certain that Google Voice numbers are supported. Many financial apps, Albert included, may not accept VoIP numbers for verification, since they need a number tied to a real mobile carrier to confirm your identity and secure your account. The most reliable option is to sign up with a number from a standard carrier (like Verizon, T-Mobile, or AT&T). If that isn't possible, try your Google Voice number during signup and contact Albert support through the app to confirm whether it will work.
